label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: url is sourced from session attribute 'partnerCallback', which is user-controllable. Although guarded by startsWith('https://') and contains(suffix), the 'contains' check is a weak whitelist allowing subdomain/domain bypasses (e.g., evil.com.suffix). Attacker-controlled data reaches the sendRedirect sink.

evidence.note: url retrieved from session and used in redirect with weak domain check
